title: rutaea quercifolia
intro: Rutaea quercifolia, commonly known as the Quercus-like Rutaea, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae, native to the tropical regions of Asia. Rutaea quercifolia has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting antioxidant activity. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive compounds in Rutaea quercifolia have been shown to exhibit strong free radical scavenging activity and to have potential anti-cancer properties.
